title: Provisional amplifier and supply envelope is absent
component_interface: 12 V supply / TAS5825M / stereo speaker load
description: The 12 V input is a target, not a proven amplifier operating point. Schematic readiness needs a defensible provisional electrical envelope even though final headroom depends on EVT measurements.

evidence.note: Final 12 V decision requires measured Vrms/Irms, THD and ANC headroom.

closure_criterion: Define a documented provisional minimum/nominal/maximum input and protected supply, stereo load/current and thermal envelope, worst-case margin method and test plan; mark final 12 V adequacy open. R2 device limits and R4 calculations must support any schematic-ready bound.
